Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Warwrit W09 static full-body combat roster sprite, one adult halberd warrior, isolated actual transparent background.
Input references: image 1 unit-c-ink.png is the approved human anatomy, body proportion, equipment weight, irregular ink and flat-wash rendering foundation. Image 2 staraya-melnitsa.png provides credible weathered materials and muted scene palette only, do not draw the mill. Image 3 battle-ux-v3.png defines the elevated three-quarter battlefield projection and screen upper-right facing. No UI or scene is reproduced.
Subject: one grounded adult human fighter with ordinary practical medieval military equipment: subdued soot/umber quilted cloth armor, leather belt and boots, a simple weathered iron open-faced helmet. No shield, no extra weapons, no heraldry. Full adult proportions, credible shoulders, arms, hands, knees and weight-bearing feet.
W09 identity: long practical halberd, visibly distinct from a spear. One straight long wooden shaft held firmly with TWO separate anatomically plausible hands spaced along it. At its far upper-right end, one matte weathered iron head has a strongly readable broad axe blade projecting to one side, a narrow long thrust point aligned with the shaft, and a modest opposing hook. Simple practical small head, never oversized fantasy axe. Keep the axe blade and thrust point visibly separate in silhouette. Weapon is around 1.3 times the adult's height, diagonally carried at a controlled ready position across the body, butt end toward lower-left and head extending upper-right, both hands visibly wrapping the same shaft. Halberd head unobscured and whole shaft visible outside the two grips.
Composition: single full-body figure, fixed elevated three-quarter view with face, torso and toes directed screen upper-right; upper-left light and deep lower-right shadows. Balanced planted combat-ready stance, no attack motion. Include whole head, both boots, entire shaft, butt, axe blade, hook, and thrust point with at least 8 percent transparent canvas margin on all sides. Choose enough canvas width so weapon is not cropped. Human intended to display at 80 px body height, weapon silhouette must read at that scale.
Style: closely match reference 1: irregular dark hand-ink contours, internal hatching, flat washes, strong shadow masses, restrained weathered surface texture; matte iron, cloth, leather and wood. Muted soot, slate, umber and ochre, restrained rust accents. Serious grounded dark fantasy, NOT stylized cartoon anatomy or cute round toy equipment; no glossy 3D renderer look.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, no background color, no scenery, no ground tile, no terrain patch, no pedestal, no painted contact shadow. No text, border, symbols, magic, glow, watermark or franchise imagery. No duplicate person, duplicate limbs, fused hands, floating fingers or cropped equipment.
